meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Almaty
days.desc: Welcome to the City of Apples, Almaty! Upon your arrival, get transferred to the hotel and check-in. After you relax for some time, explore this beautiful city on your own by visiting places like the vibrant Zelyony Bazaar and Abai Square. You can also visit the stunning Palace of President and Palace of Republic and admire their contemporary architectural styles. Later, return to the hotel at your own pace for an overnight stay.

days.title: Almaty Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, spend time exploring Almaty on a sightseeing tour. Get transferred from the hotel and see some of the city's iconic places, like the Panfilov Park, dedicated to the Panfilove heroes who took part in World War II. Then, see the beautiful Ascension Cathedral, a famous Russian Orthodox cathedral. Lastly, visit the beautiful Republic Square and see the Monument of Independence, known as the symbol of freedom for Kazakhstan. Afterward, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Trip to Green Bazaar & Rahat Chocolate Factory | Visit to Kok Tobe Park
days.desc: Today, get transferred from the hotel to Green Bazaar. In this all-in-one bazaar, you can buy all kinds of items, from souvenirs to clothes and snacks. Then, enjoy a brief stopover at Rahat Chocolate Factory to see in detail the process of chocolate as you buy a few of them. Next, get transferred to the city center to board your cable car to Kok Tobe Park, where you can enjoy rides and admire the views of the panoramic surroundings. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay

days.title: Day Trip to Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake
days.desc: In the morning, get ready to go for the day trip to Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake. Begin with a visit to the majestic Charyn Canyon, often likened to the Grand Canyon, featuring dramatic rock formations carved over millennia. Then, discover the Kolsai Lake, situated around the Tien Shan mountains. After exploring these  amazing attractions, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Day Trip to Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake From Almaty

days.title: Day Trip to Issyk Lake
days.desc: Admire the beauty of Issky Lake on a wonderful day trip. Get transferred from the hotel to Lake Issky, located in the scenic Issky Gorge. Upon reaching there, enjoy a leisurely walk around the shores as you take-in the views of the surroundings. Also, visit the State Historical and Cultural Museum-Reserve and learn about the area's past and history. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
